about_the_game:
Flowerbots is a chill and bouncy idler incremental game set in minimalist and abstract garden.

There are two teams of bots in the game: planters and harvesters, and you command them both, so it is your duty to keep the garden balanced and as efficient as possible.

Key Features

  • Prestige system. Progress between runs in a roguelite style, with randomized upgrades within runs and a prestige progression outside of them.

  • Physical simulation. Explore the bots with their own features, abilities and movement styles.

  • 30+ anomalies to conquer. Adjust your strategies and adapt your builds to solve the mini-boss levels that we call Anomalies.

  • A new take on idler incremental games. This time with a bouncy simulation, which makes all your strategies and builds physical with a touch of chaos!

If you enjoy optimizing a small physical simulation, theorizing about builds, and watching your plan unfold while numbers go up, then this game is for you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 or AMD Radeon HD 6850 (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 or AMD Radeon R9 270 (DirectX 11 compatible)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

short_description: Flowerbots is a chill and bouncy incremental game with synergies, strategic optimizations and a whole playground for your physical experiments!
